completion_gate: Driver authored complete including an unexecuted run_measurement; pilot gate run and its projection recorded; 200 uniform replicates per cell completed with every statistic recorded; apparatus-identity, product-control and BOTH perturbation ladders completed at EVERY rung; the PERTURB-MOVE-1 movement table written with one row per family, rung, cell and statistic; the driver's own Dickman solution recorded beside the frozen table; factorization verification at 1.0 with its count archived; real_object_touched false; the seven-file run package present with manifest.yaml and .log extensions; no interpretation stated; no commit made.
constraints: DO NOT RUN WITHOUT CALIBRATION_AUTHORIZATION AUTHORIZED in the TASK-20260801-048 receipt. Check it and quote it in the execution report.
AUTHOR THE DRIVER COMPLETE, INCLUDING run_measurement, AND DO NOT EXECUTE run_measurement. The driver is hash-bound at TASK-20260801-050 and the measurement stage must run this identical file.

THE CALIBRATION MUST BE STRUCTURALLY BLIND TO THE REAL OBJECT. run_calibration must contain no reference to the deterministic factor base, to the Semaev specialization or to the measurement entry point, and must write real_object_touched = false. The reviewer will check this at the level of OBJECTS and not merely of labels.

RUN THE PILOT BUDGET GATE FIRST - 10000 factorizations per cell, measure the rate, extrapolate, and ABORT BEFORE ANY BULK WORK if the projection exceeds the wall-clock budget. AN ABORT IS A BUDGET EVENT AND IS REPORTED AS ONE. DO NOT reduce R_CAL, the ladders, the cells or n to fit; a reduced-scope run reported as the planned one is the single most damaging thing this batch could produce, and any reduction requires a Coordinator protocol_amendment.

RE-VERIFY EVERY FACTORIZATION AT 100 PERCENT OF SAMPLES - each returned factor tested for primality and the product asserted equal to N - and write the counts to results/calib. STOP IMMEDIATELY on any verification failure; a wrong factorization silently poisons every statistic.
COMPUTE rho BY NUMERICAL SOLUTION OF THE DICKMAN DELAY EQUATION and record your own values beside the frozen table in dickman_reference_reproduction.json. Do not read rho from the frozen table.

WRITE THE PERTURB-MOVE-1 MOVEMENT TABLE AS MACHINE-READABLE ROWS - one row per family, rung, cell and statistic, carrying the measured shift in units of the measured null standard deviation. THIS IS THE NAMED PRIORITY DELIVERABLE OF THIS TASK. At BATCH-024 the analogous table was never produced and two plant families turned out incapable of moving the statistics they certified against.

BUILD BOTH PLANTS BY REPLACEMENT WITH INTEGERS OF KNOWN FACTORIZATION so no plant rung costs additional factorization, and record for each family which part of the Z-distribution its replacement moves mass into.
COMPUTE NO REAL-OBJECT STATISTIC OF ANY KIND. No OBJ-REAL sample, no deterministic factor-base x-list, no Semaev specialization in the calibration arm.
ADD, DROP, MOVE OR REORDER NOTHING. No statistic, rung, cut, band, ladder or branch beyond what the frozen contract fixes.
Archive a PRE-RUN `git status --porcelain` capture as git_status_prerun.txt.
manifest.yaml with command.txt, environment.json, stdout.log, stderr.log and raw-result.json beside it - note .log and not .txt. Record the exact factorization module and version in environment.json.
RECORD OBSERVATIONS ONLY. State no interpretation, recommend no disposition, and set no status.
Record inference honestly - requested policy executor-implementation, resolved model, fallback_used, model_verified.
